model_output.verdict: Your B2B SaaS marketing work at Velocity shows real management responsibility and results. The freelance work since then is much less developed, so I'd hesitate over what you've been doing most recently.
write_up: You've moved from marketing at Bridgepoint Analytics to leading demand generation at Velocity Software, then into freelance consulting. It's common for consulting work to get compressed into a couple of broad lines, but those lines are now the first work a recruiter sees. They don't yet show how much you took on or what changed for clients, so I'd likely move on despite the stronger Velocity work.

Your MQL line is the model: it names a measure, a change and the cost context alongside it. The Velocity role also makes your management responsibility concrete with a team and budget. The reduction in force explains why that role ended, and your current consulting work accounts for the time since.

Let's start with the freelance role. Add what was yours on a project, how many clients you supported and a result you can substantiate. Then give the Bridgepoint traffic and webinar work a little more substance so the earlier jobs carry their weight too.
